duration_period.description: The period of time to await between two runs of the connector.

tlp_level.description: Default TLP level of the imported entities.

alert_prefix.description: Prefix that is added in alerts titles.

delete_notification.description: Delete notification from VT after processing.

filter_with_tag.description: Only process notifications with this tag.

create_file.description: Create file observable for matched files.

max_age_days.description: Only process files submitted within this many days.

min_file_size.description: Minimum file size in bytes to download.

max_file_size.description: Maximum file size in bytes to download(default: 50MB).

min_positives.description: Minimum number of vendors marking file to download as 'malicious'.

upload_artifact.description: Upload file to OpenCTI as artifact.

create_yara_rule.description: Create YARA indicator for the matching rule.

av_list.description: Comma-separated list of AVs to add in description, (e.g., `Kaspersky,Symantec`).

livehunt_tag_prefix.description: Prefix used to state that the tag is imported from Livehunt

yara_label_prefix.description: Prefix that is added in yara labels.

livehunt_label_prefix.description: Prefix that is added in livehunt labels.

enable_label_enrichment.description: Add livehunt name and matched yara rules label to the alert

get_malware_config.description: Extract C2 infrastructure (domains, IPs, URLs) from VirusTotal's malware configuration analysis and add the resulting observables to the bundle. Only effective when `create_file` is true.

create_file_indicators.description: Create a File indicator (SHA-256 pattern) for each matched file. Only effective when `create_file` is true — the File indicator is emitted alongside the File observable in `LivehuntBuilder.create_file`, so leaving `create_file` off means this flag has no effect.

create_domain_name_indicators.description: Create Domain-Name indicators for domains extracted from the malware configuration.

create_ip_indicators.description: Create IPv4/IPv6 indicators for IP addresses extracted from the malware configuration.

create_url_indicators.description: Create URL indicators for URLs extracted from the malware configuration.

limit.description: Maximum number of notifications to process per run. Useful when the VirusTotal API quota is small. Leave unset to process every available notification.
